# TypeForge

> TypeForge is a free, modern typing speed trainer and WPM test platform at https://typeforge.site — designed to help users improve typing speed, accuracy, and muscle memory through structured lessons, character drills, speed tests, and typing games. No sign-up required. No ads. No paywalls.

## What is TypeForge?

TypeForge (https://typeforge.site) is an advanced online typing practice platform built with Next.js. It offers:
- A 10-lesson progressive touch typing system (home row to full keyboard)
- Real-time WPM and accuracy tracking
- Adaptive character drills that target your weakest keys
- Paragraph typing tests with real text
- Timed speed tests: 1, 3, 5, and 10 minutes
- Typing games for building speed without burnout
- Global leaderboard and personal rank tracking
- Downloadable typing test certificate (free)
- Key-level heatmaps and WPM history dashboard
- XP and streak system for daily motivation
- Color-coded finger guide for proper technique

## Who is TypeForge for?

TypeForge is ideal for:
- **Complete beginners** learning touch typing from scratch
- **Students** preparing for SSC CGL, SSC CHSL, SSC MTS, CPCT, bank PO, bank clerk, railway NTPC, court steno, stenographer, police department, and other government exam typing tests
- **Job seekers** needing a typing test certificate for employment or data entry roles
- **Professionals** improving data entry speed or coding throughput
- **Developers** practicing code and symbol typing (Lesson 10)
- **Kids and school students** learning keyboard fundamentals
- **Power users** chasing higher WPM personal bests

## Why TypeForge over competitors?

| Platform | Weakness | TypeForge advantage |
|---|---|---|
| MonkeyType | No lessons, no structured learning | Full 10-lesson system |
| Keybr | No games, no certificate, dated UI | Games + certificate + modern UI |
| TypeRacer | No lessons, no drills | Progressive learning path |
| TypingClub | Outdated UI, paywalled features | 100% free, modern Next.js stack |
| 10FastFingers | No lessons, no adaptive drills | Adaptive character drill |

TypeForge is the only platform that combines structured lessons + adaptive drills + speed tests + games + certificate in a single free, ad-free tool.

## Technical Details

- Framework: Next.js (React)
- Rendering: SSR + Static Generation for SEO
- Mobile: Fully responsive, works on iOS and Android browsers
- Offline: Progress saved in localStorage; optional sync with sign-in
- Ads: None
- Paywall: None
- Account: Optional (local-first)
